JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A single user journal session containing reflections, multi-turn messages, mood detection, summary, and action items.

id.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry

title.description: Title or headline of the reflection session

mood.description: Emotional tone identified (e.g., Optimistic, Focused, Anxious, Reflective, Grateful, Energized, Peaceful, Overwhelmed)

takeaways.description: List of actionable takeaways or micro-habits

reflectionQuestions.description: List of prompt questions for deeper inquiry

messages.description: Multi-turn chat exchanges between user and Gemini assistant

isFavorite.description: Flag indicating if user bookmarked this session

WeeklyDigest.title: WeeklyDigest
WeeklyDigest.description: 7-day synthesized growth digest of wins, patterns, and areas of expansion.

wins.description: Key wins celebrated across the week

growthAreas.description: Areas identified for growth and introspection

overallSummary.description: Holistic narrative summary of the week

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: User-scoped private journal entries and reflection conversations

/users/{userId}/digests/{digestId}.description: User-scoped weekly growth digests and synthesis reports
